versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* fix(appearance): bring back the app-wide Google Fonts picker by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1127
* fix: make the genre chip's searches work, in the source and the library by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1129
* fix(library) select between option by @Lukas-DS in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1131
* fix(js): send PUT, DELETE and PATCH from the extension client by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1132
* fix(migrate): search a few sources at a time and open the dialog at once by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1141
* fix(sync): persist since and lastSync in one awaited write by @sergwei in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1146
* fix(filters): skip malformed filter options instead of dropping the list by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1150
* feat(library): reopen on the last category, and keep the last row clear of the floating bar by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1122
* chore: move to Flutter 3.50 and material_ui by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1154
* fix(mass-migration): give long titles and the migrate choice room on phones by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1153
* fix(library): hide continue-reading button when caught up by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1155
* feat(detail): long press the In library heart to edit categories by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1160
* fix(chapters): show a swiped chapter as read at once by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1159
* fix(downloads): queue order, pause/resume, and move to top/bottom by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1156
* fix(reader): delete a read download once the reader closes by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1157
* Sync between devices, and a standalone sync server by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1158
* feat(library): option to hide the active filter chips by @itsyaba in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1162

## New Contributors
* @sergwei made their first contribution in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1146

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.95...v0.9.96
